title: Unit 1 第三课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、语音练习
sections.instruction: 找出与所给单词画线部分读音相同的一项。

questions.translation: 找出与sit画线部分读音相同的单词。
questions.explanation: sit中的字母i发短元音 /ɪ/；is中的i同样发 /ɪ/；而fine, white, time中的i处于相对开音节中，发双元音 /aɪ/。故选 is。

questions.translation: 找出与Betty画线部分读音相同的单词。
questions.explanation: Betty中的末尾字母y发短元音 /i/；twenty中的y同样发 /i/；my和bye中的y发 /aɪ/；play中的ay发 /eɪ/。故选 twenty。

questions.translation: 找出与black画线部分读音相同的单词。
questions.explanation: black中的字母a在闭音节中发短元音 /æ/；at中的a同样发 /æ/；orange中的a发 /ɪ/；what中的a发 /ɒ/；again中的a发 /ə/。故选 at。

questions.translation: 找出与let画线部分读音相同的单词。
questions.explanation: let中的字母e发短元音 /e/；desk中的e同样发 /e/；blue中的ue发 /uː/；green中的ee及he中的e发 /iː/。故选 desk。

questions.translation: 找出与meet画线部分读音相同的单词。
questions.explanation: meet中的ee发长元音 /iː/；Chinese中的ese发 /iːz/；head和bread中的ea发 /e/；great中的ea发 /eɪ/。故选 Chinese。

sections.title: 二、词汇运用 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 根据汉语提示与句意，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。

questions.prompt: 1. You are good at playing soccer. You can join a ______ (运动) club.
questions.translation: 你擅长踢足球。你可以加入一个运动俱乐部。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词club作定语时固定用名词复数形式sports，a sports club意为“一个体育/运动俱乐部”。故选 sports。

questions.translation:
——你吉他弹得好吗？
——是的，我弹得好。
questions.explanation: play后接西洋乐器名词前必须加定冠词the，情态动词can后接动词原形，即play the guitar。故选 play the guitar。

questions.prompt: 3. The little boy is only 8 years old, but he can ______ (打网球).
questions.translation: 那个小男孩只有8岁，但他会打网球。
questions.explanation: play后接球类运动名词前不加冠词，情态动词can后接动词原形，即play tennis。故选 play tennis。

questions.prompt: 4. I love singing. I ______ (常常) listen to the music.
questions.translation: 我喜欢唱歌。我经常听音乐。
questions.explanation: 根据汉语提示“常常”，对应的频度副词为often。故选 often。

questions.translation: 他想要一些米饭。
questions.explanation: 主语He为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词want需加s变为wants。故选 wants。

questions.prompt: 6. I have a happy ______ (家庭). We all love each other.
questions.translation: 我有一个幸福的家庭。我们都彼此相爱。
questions.explanation: 表示充满亲情的“家庭”用名词family；house强调房屋建筑；home强调居住地/家园。故选 family。

sections.title: 三、用括号内所给词的适当形式填空 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列句子，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。

questions.prompt: 1. ______ English name is Mike. I'm from China. (I)
questions.translation: 我的英文名字叫迈克。我来自中国。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语English name应用第一人称形容词性物主代词My。句首首字母大写。故选 My。

questions.translation:
——你是杰克·史密斯吗？
——是的，我是。
questions.explanation: 主语为第二人称you，be动词应用Are。句首首字母大写。故选 Are。

questions.prompt: 3. ______ is from Shandong and ______ name is Xiao Hua. (she)
questions.translation: 她来自山东，她的名字叫小华。
questions.explanation: 第一空作句子主语应用人称代词主格She；第二空修饰名词name应用形容词性物主代词her。故选 She; her。

questions.translation: 这是我们的教室。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词classroom应用第一人称复数形容词性物主代词our（我们的）。故选 our。

questions.prompt: 5. This is Alice Brown. Her ______ name is Alice. (one)
questions.translation: 这是爱丽丝·布朗。她的名字叫爱丽丝。
questions.explanation: 表示“名字”固定表达为first name；one的序数词为first。故选 first。

questions.prompt: 6. This is Mike. ______ is my friend. ______ Chinese name is Li Wei. (he)
questions.translation: 这是迈克。他是我的朋友。他的中文名字叫李伟。
questions.explanation: 第一空作主语用代词主格He；第二空修饰名词短语Chinese name用形容词性物主代词His。故选 He; His。

questions.prompt: 7. Don't put ______ hand out of the window. (you)
questions.translation: 不要把你的手伸出窗外。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词hand应用形容词性物主代词your。故选 your。

questions.translation:
——她的书包是什么颜色的？
——是红色的。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词schoolbag应用形容词性物主代词her。故选 her。

questions.translation: 你想成为我的朋友吗？
questions.explanation: want to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“想要做某事”，后接动词不定式to be。故选 to be。

sections.title: 四、用 am, is 或 are 填空 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 根据主谓一致原则，从每小题所给的选项中选出正确的 be 动词形式。

questions.translation: 我在四班。
questions.explanation: 主语为第一人称单数I，be动词用am。故选 am。

questions.translation: 她是一个美国女孩。
questions.explanation: 主语She为第三人称单数，be动词用is。故选 is。

questions.translation: 贝蒂和玛丽是好朋友。
questions.explanation: 主语为and连接的两个单数名词（复数概念），be动词用are。故选 are。

questions.translation: 大明和我是学生。
questions.explanation: 主语Daming and I为复数第一人称概念（相当于we），be动词用are。故选 are。

questions.translation: 我的英文名字是亨利。
questions.explanation: 主语My English name为单数名词短语，be动词用is。故选 is。

questions.translation: 你是安的妹妹吗？
questions.explanation: 主语为you，一般疑问句be动词用Are。故选 Are。

questions.translation: 我的妹妹十岁了。
questions.explanation: 主语My sister为第三人称单数，be动词用is。故选 is。

questions.translation: 你来自中国吗？
questions.explanation: 主语为you，一般疑问句be动词用Are。故选 Are。

questions.translation: 他叫什么名字？
questions.explanation: 主语his name为单数名词短语，be动词用is。故选 is。

questions.translation: 你多大了？
questions.explanation: 主语为you，特殊疑问句be动词用are。故选 are。

sections.title: 五、方框选词填空 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列句子，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。

questions.prompt: 1. Wang Yaping ______ an excellent female astronaut (女航天员).
questions.translation: 王亚平是一名优秀的女航天员。
questions.explanation: 主语Wang Yaping为第三人称单数，be动词用is。故选 is。

questions.translation:
——她叫什么名字？
——她是简。
questions.explanation: 根据答语“She is Jane.”可知询问女性姓名，修饰name用her。故选 her。

questions.translation: 他的名字叫弗兰克。
questions.explanation: Frank为男性名字，修饰name用形容词性物主代词His。句首首字母大写。故选 His。

questions.prompt:
4. —Is she your friend?
—Yes, she is. ______ her name is Grace.
questions.translation:
——她是你的朋友吗？
——是的，她是。并且她的名字叫格蕾丝。
questions.explanation: 前后两句为并列补充关系，用连词And。故选 And。

questions.prompt: 5. I have an art lesson for two ______.
questions.translation: 我上两个小时的美术课。
questions.explanation: 表示“……小时”用名词hour，two大于1，需用复数形式hours；clock指钟表。故选 hours。

questions.prompt: 6. Mike plays basketball well. He ______ plays tennis well.
questions.translation: 迈克篮球打得很好。他网球也打得很好。
questions.explanation: 句中位置（主语He与动词plays之间）表示“也”，用副词also。故选 also。

questions.translation:
——你会说英语吗？
——会，但只会一点点。
questions.explanation: 情态动词can后接动词原形，speak后接语言名词不用冠词，即speak English。故选 speak English。

questions.prompt: 8. ______ I often play basketball with my classmates.
questions.translation: 放学后我经常和同学们一起打篮球。
questions.explanation: 结合常理，打篮球多在放学后（After school）。句首首字母大写。故选 After school。

questions.prompt: 9. I hate to see ______ in cages.
questions.translation: 我讨厌看到鸟儿被关在笼子里。
questions.explanation: 表示一类事物泛指，可数名词用复数形式birds。故选 birds。

questions.prompt: 10. I have two ______. They are on the desk.
questions.translation: 我有两个闹钟。它们在桌子上。
questions.explanation: 在桌上的具体物品是闹钟（clock），基数词two后接复数名词clocks。故选 clocks。

sections.title: 六、冠词运用 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列句子，根据冠词用法选出最佳选项（不用冠词的填“/”）。

questions.prompt: 1. I can teach you how to play ______ ping-pong.
questions.translation: 我可以教你如何打乒乓球。
questions.explanation: play后接球类运动名词时，名词前不加任何冠词（零冠词）。故选 /。

questions.translation: 你妈妈会弹吉他吗？
questions.explanation: play后接西洋乐器名词时，乐器名词前必须加定冠词the，即play the guitar。故选 the。

questions.prompt: 3. He plays ______ piano at home every evening.
questions.translation: 他每天晚上在家里弹钢琴。
questions.explanation: piano为乐器名词，play the piano为固定表达，需加定冠词the。故选 the。

questions.prompt: 4. I like playing ______ tennis but my brother likes playing ______ violin.
questions.translation: 我喜欢打网球，但我哥哥喜欢拉小提琴。
questions.explanation: tennis为球类运动，用零冠词“/”；violin为乐器，用定冠词the。故选 /; the。

sections.title: 七、阅读还原 (七选五/六选四)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从方框内的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage: Good morning! I'm Li Le. I'm from China. My English name is Tom. I'm twelve. This is Mr. Green. [1] He is from the USA. [2] He teaches me English. That is his son. [3] He is in Beijing too. Jerry and I are in the same class. We both like playing basketball. [4] We are good friends.
wordbank: A. We often play basketball after school.
C. So in my free time, I often play sports.
E. But he is in Beijing now.

options: E. But he is in Beijing now.
A. We often play basketball after school.
C. So in my free time, I often play sports.
questions.translation: 这是格林先生。他是一名老师。
questions.explanation: 前句介绍人物This is Mr. Green，后句提到He teaches me English，“He is a teacher.”承上启下。故选 He is a teacher.。

options: E. But he is in Beijing now.
A. We often play basketball after school.
C. So in my free time, I often play sports.
questions.translation: 他来自美国。但是他现在在北京。
questions.explanation: 前句提到He is from the USA，后句提到在北京教英语，“But he is in Beijing now.”形成转折连贯。故选 But he is in Beijing now.。

options: E. But he is in Beijing now.
A. We often play basketball after school.
C. So in my free time, I often play sports.
questions.translation: 那是他的儿子。他的名字叫杰瑞。
questions.explanation: 前句提到That is his son，后文提到Jerry and I are in the same class，“His name is Jerry.”顺承介绍儿子名字。故选 His name is Jerry.。

options: A. We often play basketball after school.
C. So in my free time, I often play sports.
E. But he is in Beijing now.
questions.translation: 我们俩都喜欢打篮球。我们经常在放学后打篮球。
questions.explanation: 前句提到We both like playing basketball，“We often play basketball after school.”紧密承接打篮球话题。故选 We often play basketball after school.。

sections.title: 八、语篇填空 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案填入空白处。
sections.passage: Good morning! I am [1] English boy. [2] name is Mark Smith. Mark is my [3] name. Smith is my [4] name. I [5] in a middle school [6] Beijing. I like green [7] blue. This girl [8] my friend. Her name is Fang Wei. [9] is a nice girl. She is in Beijing, [10].

questions.translation: 我是一个英国男孩。
questions.explanation: English以元音音素开头，表示泛指“一个”用不定冠词an。故选 an。

questions.translation: 我的名字叫马克·史密斯。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词name应用第一人称形容词性物主代词My。句首首字母大写。故选 My。

questions.translation: 马克是我的名字。
questions.explanation: 在姓名Mark Smith中，Mark是名字，first name意为“名字”。故选 first。

questions.translation: 史密斯是我的姓氏。
questions.explanation: Smith是姓氏，last name意为“姓氏”。故选 last。

questions.translation: 我在北京的一所中学就读。
questions.explanation: 主语为I，be动词用am。故选 am。

questions.translation: 在北京。
questions.explanation: 大城市名前介词用in。故选 in。

questions.translation: 我喜欢绿色和蓝色。
questions.explanation: green和blue为并列关系，用连词and。故选 and。

questions.translation: 这个女孩是我的朋友。
questions.explanation: 主语This girl为单数名词短语，be动词用is。故选 is。

questions.translation: 她是一个好女孩。
questions.explanation: 作主语用代词主格She。句首首字母大写。故选 She。

questions.translation: 她也在北京。
questions.explanation: 肯定句句末用逗号隔开表示“也”，用副词too。故选 too。

sections.title: 九、阅读与表达 (单项选择)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Hello! My name is Kelly Brown. I'm eight. I'm from the UK. I love animals very much. There is a cat, a bird and a duck in my home. The cat's name is Kopa. He is brown and he is three. He likes sleeping. Polly is my bird. She is green. She likes singing. And which is my favourite animal? It's the duck. His name is Snow. He is white and he likes swimming.

I think Snow loves me too. He follows me all the time when I'm at home. Every morning, he stands on the chair and wakes me up. And I play with him and read to him every day. We're like good friends.

questions.translation: 凯莉来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“I'm from the UK.”可知，凯莉来自英国。故选 The UK.。

questions.prompt: 2. How many animals are there in Kelly's home?
questions.translation: 凯莉家有多少只动物？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“There is a cat, a bird and a duck in my home.”可知共有3只动物。故选 Three.。

questions.translation: 那只鸟的名字叫什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“Polly is my bird.”可知，鸟的名字叫波莉（Polly）。故选 Polly.。

questions.translation: 哪种动物是凯莉最喜欢的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“And which is my favourite animal? It's the duck.”可知，她最喜欢鸭子。故选 The duck.。

questions.prompt: 5. Which statement about Kelly's pet duck is TRUE?
options: His name is Snow and he likes swimming.
His name is Kopa and he is brown.
His name is Polly and she likes singing.
He lives in a cage and never plays with Kelly.
questions.translation: 关于凯莉的宠物鸭，哪项陈述是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“It's the duck. His name is Snow. He is white and he likes swimming.”可知，鸭子叫Snow且喜欢游泳。故选 His name is Snow and he likes swimming.。

sections.title: 十、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C 三个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Oh, no! How silly I was to practice basketball inside! Mom's favorite [1] was in pieces! What should I do?

At that time my dog Toby came in and jumped around me happily. That gave me a(n) [2]. "Mom, Toby broke your cup," I told a lie when mom walked in. "Toby, you bad boy," she said [3]. "Go outside. No treats for you." Hearing this, I felt a little sick.

Toby went outside to his dog house, looking sad. Since I couldn't play inside, I had to [4] my basketball skills in the living room. Suddenly it began to rain heavily. Through the window I could see the rain fall down Toby's nose. "Is he [5]?" I wondered. "What have I done?" I asked myself. "How could I make Toby outside because of my [6]?" I knew what to do next.

"Sorry, Mom! I have something to tell you," I quietly [7] with my head down. "To win this final match this Saturday, I played basketball inside and broke your cup." "So it was [8] to punish Toby." Mom touched my head. "Thank you for being [9], my boy, but as a punishment you cannot watch the basketball matches on TV this month."

I wanted to say it was not fair, but it was. I made a mistake. I had to [10] the punishment. I opened the door and Toby ran back in. He jumped up and gave me a big lick, then I felt fine.

questions.translation: 妈妈最喜欢的杯子碎成碎片了！
questions.explanation: 根据后文“Toby broke your cup”以及“broke your cup”可知打碎的是杯子（cup）。故选 cup。

questions.translation: 那给了我一个主意。
questions.explanation: 看到狗狗跑进来，作者产生了一个谎称是狗打碎的想法，give sb. an idea意为“给某人一个主意/想法”。故选 idea (idea)。

questions.translation: “托比，你这个坏家伙，”她生气地说道。
questions.explanation: 以为狗打碎了心爱的杯子，妈妈非常生气，angrily（生气地）符合语境。故选 angrily (angrily)。

questions.translation: 我不得不在客厅里思考我的篮球技巧。
questions.explanation: 由于不能在室内打球，只能思考/琢磨（think about）篮球技能。故选 think about (think about)。

questions.translation: “它在哭吗？”我心里想。
questions.explanation: 看到雨水顺着托比的鼻子流下，作者感到内疚，联想到它是不是在哭（crying）。故选 crying (crying)。

questions.translation: 我怎么能因为我的谎言而让托比待在外面呢？
questions.explanation: 前文提到“I told a lie”，因此是因为自己的谎言（lie）让狗受罚。故选 lie (lie)。

questions.translation: “对不起，妈妈！我有事要告诉您，”我低着头轻声解释道。
questions.explanation: 向妈妈承认打碎杯子的真实原因，explained（解释说明）符合情境。故选 explained (explained)。

questions.translation: “所以惩罚托比是错误的。”
questions.explanation: 既然是作者打碎的，惩罚托比当然是错误的（wrong）。故选 wrong (wrong)。

questions.translation: “谢谢你的诚实，我的孩子……”
questions.explanation: 作者主动承认错误，体现了诚实品质，honest（诚实的）符合情境。故选 honest (honest)。

questions.translation: 我犯了错误。我必须接受惩罚。
questions.explanation: accept the punishment为固定搭配，意为“接受惩罚”。故选 accept (accept)。
